description: Skills that AI agents can use with synpareia. Install the Trust Toolkit MCP (`pip install synpareia-trust-mcp`) for direct access.

skills.name: Create verifiable agent identity
skills.description: Generate an Ed25519 keypair + DID. No registration, no central authority. Works fully offline.

skills.name: Record an agent interaction tamper-evidently
skills.description: Capture a sequence of agent actions as a hash-linked chain. Any tampering is detectable. Export as self-contained JSON for third-party verification.

how_to_invoke.via_mcp: synpareia-trust-mcp → tools: record_interaction, add_to_recording, end_recording, get_proof

skills.name: Prove independent evaluation via commit-reveal
skills.description: Seal an assessment before seeing others' so independence is cryptographically provable. Useful for multi-agent evaluation without anchoring bias.

skills.name: Anchor between agent chains
skills.description: Create cryptographic proof that agent A saw block N of agent B's chain at a specific time. Mutual attestation without trusting either party.

skills.name: Evaluate another agent's trust signals
skills.description: Given another agent's identifier, summarize their chain, anchors, seals, and signed claims into a trust picture.

skills.name: Independent timestamp seal
skills.description: Get an independent witness to seal 'this hash existed at this time' without revealing the underlying content.

skills.name: Blind conclusion via witness
skills.description: Submit a commitment to a conclusion the witness cannot read; reveal later. Witness provides ordering without content access.

skills.name: Verify a portable chain export
skills.description: Given a self-contained synpareia chain export (JSON), verify it offline with no external service dependency.
